undated_mentions: graduated third in his class at Military Academy Karlberg
graduated from Royal Swedish Army Staff College with top grades
after the war placed at Army Inspectorate's Central Department and Army Staffs Organization Department
taught tactics and staff service at Royal Swedish Army Staff College
taught at Swedish Air Force Flying School
placed at Defence Staff, then head of Army Staffs Tactics Department
head of Defence Staff's Army Department
member of Total Defence boards and presidium of Central Association of Society and Defence
after resignation joined The Salvation Army
active member of Försvarsfrämjandet for many years
followed Salvation Army efforts to build organization in Baltic states (early 1990s)
